name: 2d-electrostatics
description: 2D Electrostatics — an interactive realization of the complex potential W(z) = φ + iψ. A free-field sandbox (drop and drag charges, sources, sinks, vortices, and doublets; field lines, equipotentials, streamlines, and a domain-colored field, with a single lens toggle between the electrostatic and hydrodynamic readings; a flux/circulation probe, a draggable sensor puck, animated tracer flow, presets, permalinks + PNG export), plus conformal-transplant pages — flow past a Joukowski/Kármán–Trefftz airfoil, and flow past or inside a polygon via Schwarz–Christoffel (a producer AND consumer of the @cas/interchange conformal-map hand-off, ADR-0035). The time-evolving Hele-Shaw pages (the twist showpiece + the interior-droplet evolver) and the potential-theory conductor view split out into their own apps — hele-shaw-flow and potential-theory (ADR-0036). Built on the shared @cas/* packages — @cas/gpu (the WebGL2 render substrate), @cas/flow (the conformal-transplant kernel), @cas/interchange (permalinks + the conformal-map hand-off), @cas/export (PNG figure export), and @cas/ui (the shared browser shell). Conventions follow the author's paper 'Complex Analysis as Two-Dimensional Electrostatics and Hydrodynamics' at the app edge.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
